description_en: Queries the X.509 certificate information of a product
description_zh: 调用该接口获取产品的X.509证书信息
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-product-cert-info --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --product-key a2YwD230000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryProductCertInfo

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the ID of the instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.****

>  If your instance has an ID, you must specify the ID for this parameter. If you do not specify the instance ID, the call fails. If no Overview page or ID is generated for your instance, you do not need to configure this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
